/appearances/ethcc-2026/.title: Why Verification Should Be a 1st Class Citizen in AI | Jake Salerno
/appearances/ethcc-2026/.description: At EthCC[9], Jake Salerno presented the case for treating verification as a core requirement of AI systems. The official session archive describes a talk about transparency, trust, and the risks of closed, centralized models.

/appearances/scaling-summit-2026/.title: The End of Blind Faith | Jake Salerno
/appearances/scaling-summit-2026/.description: Jake Salerno delivered “The End of Blind Faith” at The Scaling Summit: House of AI during ETHDenver 2026. The 0G event recap identifies his keynote and its central principle: trust in AI should be supported by verification.

/appearances/token2049-2025/.title: AI Without Limits: Scaling Intelligence on the Blockchain | Jake Salerno
/appearances/token2049-2025/.description: Jake Salerno and 0G co-founder and CTO Ming Wu explored the relationship between AI and blockchain in a joint keynote at TOKEN2049 Singapore. Jake guided the conversation from 0G’s vision to its architecture, adoption, and plans for builders.

/appearances/0g-dev-day-2026/.title: Beyond Scale: Where Does AI Go From Here? | Jake Salerno
/appearances/0g-dev-day-2026/.description: At 0G Dev Day, Jake Salerno moderated “Beyond Scale: Where Does AI Go From Here?” with Scott Dernley, Airkin Wu, and Ismael Hishon-Rezaizadeh. The organizer’s agenda lists the panel at National Gallery Singapore, beginning at 4:05 PM on October 5, 2026.

/appearances/agentic-finance-2026/.title: Agentic Finance: Autonomous Capital, Execution, and AI-Native Markets | Jake Salerno
/appearances/agentic-finance-2026/.description: Jake Salerno joined the Multichain Day panel “Agentic Finance: Autonomous Capital, Execution, and AI-Native Markets” in Singapore with Charles de Pue and Dean Tribble. The session considered what changes when AI agents can execute financial transactions rather than only suggest them.
